newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Eletrobras's bid specs seen out soon.
newsitem.headline: Eletrobras's bid specs seen out soon.

text.p: Brazil's government is expected to publish in the next few days bid specifications to hire consultants to advise on sale of state-owned power utility Eletrobras' units, Gazeta Mercantil newspaper reported.

The winning bidders will make a financial and economic evaluation of Eletrobras's four power generating units Furnas, Eletrosul, Eletronorte and Chesf, which together had assets totalling 40 billion reais, Gazeta quoted Eletrobras president Firmino Sampaio as saying.
Sampaio said Furnas will be Eletrobras's first power generating unit to be privatized, but its sale is unlikely by the end of this year, the newspaper said.
No Eletrobras officials were immediately available to confirm the report.

Ahead of its privatization, Furnas will hold on Jan 29 a shareholders meeting to approve an asset restructuring plan in which the company will transfer its nuclear plants to Eletrobras' subsidiary Nuclen. This step would leave Furnas with seven hydroelectric and two thermoelectric plants.
Furnas had to transfer its nuclear plants to Nuclen because nuclear power generation is still a monopoly of the Brazilian government and it was not included in the country's privatization program.
